entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one. For all other inquiries, please press two.
Ugh, one.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's not working right and I want my money back.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, hold on. It's VF-987654321.
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse, delivered about 15 days ago. Is that correct?
Sounds about right. I've been busy. So just send me the return label. The thing is useless.

I understand your frustration with the product. One moment while I initiate the return process... hmm. Sir, I'm sorry, but it looks like the system is flagging this item as outside the return window. Our policy is 14 days from the date of delivery.
You cannot be serious. It's one day? ONE day late and you're telling me I'm stuck with a broken piece of junk? This is ridiculous.
I do apologize for the inconvenience. The system is quite strict and automatically locks returns once the 14-day period has passed.
So that's it? You're just going to read a script and not help me? I want to speak to a manager.
That won't be necessary. Look... between you and me, I can see it's only been 15 days. Technically, I'm not supposed to do this, but as a **one-time exception**, I'm going to see what I can do.
So you can fix it?
My **manager would kill me** if he found out, but honestly, this seems silly to argue over one day. I'm going to **override the system** for you right now and push the return through.
Oh. Wow. Really? You can do that?
It's done. I've just authorized the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. You should see it within the next five minutes.
Thank you! I really appreciate you doing that. I was about to lose my mind.

It's no problem at all. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thanks again, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
